thumbnail_prompt: ONE image, both arms. The VIEWER, not a performer — measured 6.11% CTR for a person waking vs 3.03% for a musician playing. Dawn light across a doorway, a person standing barefoot with a cup, unhurried, looking out. Pichwai/Kangra miniature, aged parchment ground, ornate border. A bansuri may rest at the frame edge; it must NOT be the subject, and must not be held or played. Text in its own banner panel at ~35% of frame, second tier 'Bansuri · Raga Bhairav'. Legible at 120px.
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals, no humming — gentle Indian classical bansuri in Raga Bageshri, breath-driven bamboo flute with long sustained notes and natural breath pauses, warm night character, no percussion, steady tanpura drone, 60 BPM, seamless loop.
suno_prompt_note: Bageshri is a night raga and is NOT all-komal, deliberately avoiding the Malkauns-at-48-BPM spec that put Snowy Night at 7.2% AVD. 60 BPM per the user's banked insight 2026-09-14: this channel's working sleep music runs FASTER than the 45-55 table; slow drags. ⛔ claim_check before rendering.
